name: arcosian-community
description: Community and team-tools adapter for arcosian: GitHub's official MCP server (read-only by default) and Sentry's official remote MCP server, with a skill on GitHub for game teams, Discord and devlogs, Steam and itch.io community pages, and crash and feedback triage. Nothing is posted without human approval.

github_token.title: GitHub personal access token
github_token.description: Fine-grained personal access token sent as a Bearer header to GitHub's remote MCP server. Grant read-only repository permissions unless you also switch the server to write mode.
